data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2020 the syndicate's gross claims outstanding at the start of the year (31 Dec 2019) was $609.34m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle shows a net prior-year adverse development of approximately $12.0m (about 1.97% of opening reserves) across underwriting years 2011-2018, driven largely by deterioration in the 2018 underwriting year (notably US property catastrophe activity) partially offset by favourable development on earlier years (2017 and prior). Key affected lines include Property (Property D&F, Property Binders, Property Treaty) and Casualty (US Open Market liability). The syndicate completed a split RITC (transferring 2017 & prior liabilities to Syndicate 1994) which reduced the exposure to further adverse prior-year development.
raw_causal_phrases: This comprises losses of $13.8m on the 2018 pure year of account and a profit of $10.7m on the development of the 2017 and prior years of account during the 2020 calendar year.
The total net cost to Syndicate 1969 of these events for the 2020 calendar year was $23.4m, of which $20.9m was from Property D&F and Property Binders.

Improved profitability and combined ratio achieved despite an unusually active North Atlantic wind season with Hurricane Sally and Laura estimated to cost $21.5m and adding 8% points to the combined ratio;
Comparatively modest COVID-19 related losses with estimated net cost to Syndicate 1969 for the 2020 calendar year of $13.6m;

2018... incurred significant losses from the natural catastrophe events that occurred in 2018, namely Hurricanes Florence and Michael, whilst Typhoons Jebi and Trami and the Californian wildfires further impacted the Property Treaty class.

The US Open Market sub-class of the Non-Marine Liability account was adversely affected by a number of individual large losses, due to an increase in the frequency of claims and a higher percentage of insureds making claims.
The Marine & Energy Liability account suffered losses from the adverse performance of one particular facility, whilst the performance of the core book was within expectations.
The RITC of the 2017 and prior years liabilities removes the risk of adverse reserving development from Syndicate 1969.

data.data_quality_notes: Amounts are presented in the syndicate's functional currency (USD) and reported here in millions USD. The explicit gross prior-year movement note (insurance-liabilities column) was not located; prior-year development has been calculated from the gross claims development triangle (pages 45). The triangle may be influenced by RITC activity (split RITC described) and therefore triangle-based PYD may not fully reflect reinsurance/RITC adjustments; reconciliation text references both a $10.7m favourable development on 2017-and-prior and a $13.8m loss on the 2018 pure year leading to the closed-year loss of $3.16m. Where class-level amounts for prior-year movements are not explicitly stated, amounts are left null and confidence lowered accordingly.
